note: Lessons removed from the library (off-spec for the portal's KS4 specifications, a subject or key stage not offered, or a duplicate). Retire a lesson by removing it from content/lessons/<subject>/<year>.json AND listing it here: upload-decks then deletes its portal row, versions and files; build-decks, revision packs, booklets, coverage and merge-lessons skip it; validate fails if it is still in a lesson file. Lesson numbers listed here are never reused. title and reason are for people; scripts match on subject_slug, year and lesson_no (merge-lessons also skips a staged lesson with a retired title).
